no04.summary: Galgano Borghesi, orator at Naples, writes to Leonardo Benvoglienti that at his urging King Alfonso wanted the settlement to include the promises made when Lucca was besieged by the Florentines, and that the Pope, the Florentine clergy and the cardinals are to contribute against the Turk. The sense is tentative: 114 of the 144 cipher signs are given a value.

snip.cap: No. 4, the alphabet fragment below the text: l m n o over their cipher signs
snip.credit: Archivio di Stato di Siena, Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 4, via DECODE R4793

system: Cipher runs in capitals, digits and signs inside clear Italian, one sign per letter as far as read, with Latin code words (Calor = duca, storps = Lucca, cras = parte, Matto/Maffo = papa).
